CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [dbo].[GetAssetColorJsonByColor] ( @Color Varchar(100) ) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( WITH DUAL AS (select 'X' COL) select ( select * from ( select 'Custom' as [Name], @Color as [Value] from DUAL A1 where (substring(@Color, 1, 1) = '#' or substring(@Color, 1, 3) = 'hsl') union all select C.[Name], C.[Value] from Color C where C.ID = try_cast(@Color as int) and @Color is not null and substring(coalesce(@Color,''), 1, 1) <> '#' and substring(coalesce(@Color,''), 1, 3) <> 'hsl'
) C for json path, without_array_wrapper ) as ColorJson )
